notes: CR 603.10a (leaves-the-battlefield abilities look back in time) with CR 122.2 (counters cease to exist when the object leaves): Basri's Lieutenant, 'Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.' Your Bear with one +1/+1 counter (a 3/3) dies to 3 damage: it HAD the counter, so a Knight is created, although the card in the graveyard has none. A Bear without a counter that dies makes no Knight.
